text:
isabel: Huge public kudos to @diego (office-ops) and @maya (facilities) for coordinating the return of our lost Redwood mascot plushie 'Red' after someone left it on the 7:15 train. commuter found it and dropped it at the 1st Ave kiosk. tacos on me at lunch for the retrievers! :taco: :heart:
diego: wild story  commuter named Sam flagged it to transit staff, they brought it to the kiosk, i swung by between calls and collected it. Red is slightly dustier but alive. :bust_in_silhouette: :paw_prints:
maya: facilities helped get a quick clean and a tiny bandana on Red. also labeled him "office mascot" and put him on the reception couch. thanks to Sam and transit staff for being good humans. :sparkles: :scarf:
rhea: people-ops chiming in  organizing a tiny taco drop at 12:30 in the kitchen (label: "Red-return tacos"). will put a thank-you note for Sam in the kudos doc. :memo: :taco:
commute-bot: lost_and_found: "MASCOT-RED" reported found at 07:42 by transit staff at 1st Ave kiosk. turned in at reception 08:05.
tom: whoa excellent. quick Q: did the mascot bring any stickers with it? mine seems to have lost a sticker sleeve in the adventure. :eyes: :label:
emma: i took a selfie with Red at reception  posting in #random-pics. Red approves of the bandana. :camera: :sparkling_heart:
isabel: love the selfies. leaving this public so leadership sees the cross-team kindness. if you grabbed a taco, drop an emoji and tag one person you want to thank. extra thanks to Sam and transit staff  we should send a little care package. :raised_hands: :tada:
rhea: follow-up: adding this thread to the monthly kudos roundup and sending a small gift card to the transit kiosk staff who helped. please drop any micro-kudos below so i can include names. :gift:
taco-bot: order: 24 tacos placed at 11:50 by rhea  ETA pickup 12:20  label: "Red-return tacos". :robot_face: :taco:
